detail.longDescription: 🦅 US Government's Cloud.gov Drops Redis in Favor of Valkey ｢ As for the reason behind the decision, Cloud gov explicitly points to Redis’s licensing changes in 2024. Those changes prompted the creation of Valkey as a community-led fork of the previously open-source Redis codebase ｣ https:// linuxiac.com/us-governments-cl oud-gov-drops-redis-in-favor-of-valkey/ # redis # valkey # opensource
